name: Koikuchi soy sauce
definition: the common dark Japanese soy sauce of soybeans and wheat.
notes: Shop guide names Yamaki Jozo and Yugeta organic shoyu as koikuchi

name: Usukuchi soy sauce
notes: Higashimaru Usukuchi Light Soy Sauce 1L sold, Kansai category

name: Tamari soy sauce
definition: soy sauce brewed mainly from soybeans, with little or no wheat.
notes: San-J Organic Tamari sold in Soy Sauce & Tamari category; wheat-free

name: Saishikomi soy sauce
definition: twice-brewed soy sauce, made with soy sauce in place of brine.
notes: Yugeta Double Brewed Shoyu, Suehiro Double Brewed Sashimi Soy Sauce

name: Shiro soy sauce
definition: very pale soy sauce made mostly from wheat.
notes: Nitto Jozo White Shiro Tamari named under shiro

name: Fermented chilli paste (gochujang)
definition: a fermented paste of chilli, glutinous rice and soybeans used to season.
notes: Sempio Gochujang fermented red chili paste sold; sun-dried Korean red chili, rice

name: Broad-bean chilli paste (doubanjiang)
definition: a fermented paste of broad beans and chilli used to season.
notes: Lintao Pixian Chili Bean Sauce 750g sold on joybuy

name: Fermented soybean paste
definition: a fermented paste of soybeans, with or without grain, used to season.
notes: CHUNG JUNG ONE Doenjang soybean paste 500g and Chinese soybean paste sold

name: Oyster sauce and hoisin sauce
definition: thick dark Chinese cooking sauces of oyster extract or of fermented soybeans.
notes: Tasting of Lee Kum Kee oyster sauce, Kikkoman hoisin

name: Tomato pasta sauces
definition: tomato-based sauces for pasta, in jars, with or without meat.
notes: Tasting of jarred marinara: Mezzetta, Rao's, Carbone, Bertolli
